senses.gloss:
Dṛbhīka is the name of a man or a demon, who, according to the Rigveda, was slain by indra.
Foot notes Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 152, 207, who compares the Derbikes; Macdonell, Vedic Mythology, p. 162.
Grassmann, Wo7rterbuch, s.v.; Roth, St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.; Geldner, Rigveda, Glossar, 85.
ii. 14, 3.
